services.title: Radiography Testing (RT / CR / DR)
services.desc: X-ray and gamma radiography using Iridium-192, Selenium-75 and Cobalt-60 sources, with mobile radiography units and close proximity systems. Computed and digital radiography give instant high-resolution capture on site.
services.standards: ASME Sec V · ISO 17636 · UAEC / TAEC Licensed

services.title: Digital and Computed Radiography
services.desc: Digital image capture for faster interpretation, simpler archiving and immediate sharing of results with the client. Takes film processing off the critical path on shutdown work.

services.title: Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
services.desc: Thickness measurement, flaw detection and material characterisation across metals, plastics, composites and ceramics. Used for corrosion mapping, weld inspection and in-service monitoring.
services.standards: ASME Sec V · ISO 16810 · ASNT Level II / III

services.title: Advanced Ultrasonics (PAUT / TOFD / AUT)
services.desc: Phased array, time of flight diffraction and automated ultrasonic testing for weld inspection and accurate defect sizing, with encoded data for repeatable comparison between inspections.
services.standards: ASME Sec V Art 4 · ISO 13588 · ISO 10863

services.title: Magnetic Particle and Liquid Penetrant Testing
services.desc: Surface and near surface flaw detection on welds, castings and machined components, carried out on site or in the workshop with wet and dry techniques.

services.title: Eddy Current and Pulsed Eddy Current
services.desc: Corrosion under insulation screening on carbon steel structures without stripping cladding, plus surface crack detection on conductive materials.

services.title: Pipeline Inspection
services.desc: X-ray crawler radiography and automated ultrasonic testing of girth welds for cross-country pipelines, with crews and units mobilised to right-of-way locations.

services.title: Pigging and Intelligent Pigging
services.desc: Cleaning pigs to remove deposits and restore flow, and intelligent pigs to inspect and map pipeline wall condition along the full length of the line.

services.title: Tank and Tube Inspection (MFL)
services.desc: Magnetic flux leakage inspection of storage tank floors and heat exchanger tubes, detecting wall loss, pitting and circumferential cracking ahead of failure.

services.title: Underwater and Marine NDT
services.desc: Inspection of jetties, dams, bridge piers, hulls and other submerged structures by certified underwater inspection personnel.

services.title: Destructive Testing and Laboratory Services
services.desc: Mechanical testing, chemical analysis, coating and corrosion testing, and failure analysis, supporting weld procedure qualification and root cause investigation.

services.title: Radiation Safety and BARC NDT Training
services.desc: Industry recognised training and certification, including radiation safety certification for industrial radiographers, delivered in collaboration with the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre.

services.title: Robotic and Remote Inspection
services.desc: Crawler and remote access systems for confined, elevated or high temperature assets that cannot be entered safely, keeping inspection going without a shutdown.

services.title: Heat Treatment and Stress Relieving
services.desc: Pre-heating, post weld heat treatment and stress relieving of welded joints and pressure equipment, with recorded thermal cycles for the client dossier.

services.title: Visual Inspection and Helium Leak Testing
services.desc: Certified visual inspection to code, and helium leak testing for vessels, exchangers and sealed systems where tightness must be proven.
services.standards: ASME Sec V Art 9 and 10 · ISO 20485

services.title: NDT Equipment Supply and Maintenance
services.desc: Supply, calibration and maintenance of NDT equipment, with service support held in the region rather than shipped in for every fault.
